  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><h3 style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong> POLICIES</strong></h3><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Children 12+ welcome. </strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Self check-in any time after 3:00 pm. Check-out is 11:00am. You are welcome to enjoy the common area until noon.</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>2 night minimum stay is required for most summer weekends. Some holiday weekends require 3 night minimum.</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Singles deduct $10/night. Additional person in North or Garden Room is $10<br>5+ night stays can deduct $25/night*  (*discount cannot be combined with other promotions)</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong> 12.75% state and county lodging taxes will be added to your total.</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Please be aware we are not ADA Compliant because of stair access to the front door. </strong><br>The main access to the B&amp;B is up a series of 1-2 steps (5 total). Inside, the Nautical and North are down a hallway with no steps and the Garden and South are down a hallway up 3 steps.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>PETS:</strong><br>Sorry, absolutely <strong>no pets(no matter how cute, tiny or well-behaved)</strong> are allowed<strong>.* <br><em>Qualified Service Animals who perform specific tasks for individuals with a disability may be an exception and arrangements must be made at the time of your reservation.<br>*</em></strong>Please note: <br><strong><em>Emotional support animals, comfort animals, and therapy dogs are not service animals under Title II and Title III of the ADA, even with a doctor’s note. They need to find a pet-friendly place to stay. </em></strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>DEPOSITS: </strong>Your credit card number is required to hold your room, but will not be charged until your stay.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>CANCELLATIONS:</strong> 7 days notice of cancellation is required.  If cancellation is less than 7 days, you will be charged one night’s rent unless the room is rebooked.  <em>During high season (mid June thru Labor Day), last minute changes to the length of your stay will result in charge for each cancelled night that the house remains unbooked.</em></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>We are a SMOKE AND VAPE FREE home.</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>We regret we can offer no AAA, senior or other discounts. </strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Visa, MC, Amex and Discover cards accepted.</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><br><br></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p></div>
